data.title: 角楯花凛 · 晨光居室的连帽卫衣小憩
data.description: 夏莱公寓明朗的清晨，花凛穿着宽松舒适的浅灰无袖连帽运动卫衣与短裤。她赤足踩在地毯上，双手举过头顶舒展着充满力量感的健美腰肢，腹肌若隐若现。晨光洒落在她如融化巧克力般细腻的小麦色皮肤上，转过身来嘴角带着难得舒缓的微笑，向你递来刚热好的早餐牛奶。
data.location: sunlit modern apartment living room with open balcony door
data.action: stretching arms overhead standing barefoot on rug, sleeveless grey hoodie, dark skin midriff showing, bright warm smile looking at viewer
data.lighting: fresh golden morning sunlight washing over the apartment
data.mood: healthy athletic vitality, endearing domestic warmth
data.promptProse: Stretching her arms overhead in the bright morning sunlight, Kakudate Karin stands barefoot on the rug wearing a casual sleeveless hoodie. Golden rays highlight her toned dark skin and midriff as she smiles warmly.
data.animaCaption: Karin stretching barefoot in a sleeveless hoodie in sunlit living room with a warm smile.
